12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

3296|10e6748a.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|10e6748a.text: Arnok makes good bandages.  Find him at the Survival of the Fittest hut on the shore of the lake next to Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  It's above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

1195-complete.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-complete.text: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
1195-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1196-accept.text:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
1196-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1918-accept.name: Unknown
1918-accept.text:
The slain elemental has produced an intensely glowing globe of water.  The contents of the globe are, at best, disgusting.  It would be safe to assume that whatever has befouled the water of Mystral Lake is most likely present in the water of the globe.

It's not exactly common knowledge who might be interested in such a find; perhaps the person who originally sent you out to the lake, Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, might have an idea.
1918-accept.title: The Befouled Element

2-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-complete.text:
Most impressive, $N... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get!  The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!

Sharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post.  No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!
2-complete.title: Sharptalon's Claw

216-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
216-accept.text:
The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion!  Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post.  It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.

$N, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!

Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs.  You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
216-accept.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

216-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
216-complete.text:
Well done $c, well done!  I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements.  The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!

You've earned your pay this day, hero.  I salute you!
216-complete.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

23-accept.name: Unknown
23-accept.text:
<The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.  On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.

The paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.>
23-accept.title: Ursangous's Paw

23-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
23-progress.text: Ah - $N - I was just thinking about you!  How goes your hunting?
23-progress.title: Ursangous's Paw

6462-complete.name: Mitsuwa
6462-complete.text:
You found them!  Thank you!  Thank you, $N!  You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.

A troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...

Worthless.
6462-complete.title: Troll Charm

6462-progress.name: Mitsuwa
6462-progress.text: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
6462-progress.title: Troll Charm

6504-complete.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-complete.text: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, $N!
6504-complete.title: The Lost Pages

6504-progress.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-progress.text: I hope you find the pages soon, $N! I really need to get back to work!
6504-progress.title: The Lost Pages

6543-complete.name: Kadrak
6543-complete.text: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. We can now plan our next move.
6543-complete.title: The Warsong Reports

6543-progress.name: Kadrak
6543-progress.text: Hurry, $N. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
6543-progress.title: The Warsong Reports

6581-complete.name: Pixel
6581-complete.text: This is perfect -- just the thing! Well, here's the shipment.
6581-complete.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6621-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-accept.text:
$N, another tribe of Furbolgs,  the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar.  They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat.  With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound.  They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe.  Bring me the totem he carries.

Gather your allies, $N.  This is no task for a single $c.
6621-accept.title: King of the Foulweald

6921-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

$N, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
6921-accept.title: Amongst the Ruins
